body.statement: For any finite weighted partition, any eligible union \(E\) of current cells, and any \(w\) with \(0\leq w\leq\Pr(E)\), \(\operatorname{TAKE}(E,w)\) selects a measurable union of whole current cells and at most one part of one further cell having mass exactly \(w\).  Recording membership in the selected set refines the partition by at most one positive-mass cell and preserves all previous cell labels.  If \(w=0\), or if \(\Pr(E)=0\), no split is made.  If every current cell mass and \(w\) is an integer multiple of \(\delta>0\), every refined cell mass remains an integer multiple of \(\delta\).
body.proof_tex:
Order the eligible cells as \(C_1,\ldots,C_v\), with masses \(u_1,\ldots,u_v\).  If \(w=0\), select the empty set.  Otherwise let \(t\) be the least index for which \(\sum_{a=1}^t u_a\geq w\); it exists because \(w\leq\sum_a u_a\).  Select all of \(C_1,\ldots,C_{t-1}\) and select from \(C_t\) a part of mass
\[
 w-\sum_{a=1}^{t-1}u_a\in[0,u_t].
\]
Only \(C_t\) can be split, so all old labels persist and at most one positive-mass cell is added.  If \(\Pr(E)=0\), the premise forces \(w=0\), which is the preceding branch.  Finally, if \(u_a,w\in\delta\mathbb Z\), then the displayed residual and its complement in \(C_t\) also belong to \(\delta\mathbb Z\).  This proves every assertion, including the boundary cases.
body.justification: This is the finite-cell allocation invariant needed for zero-mass safety, support accounting, and denominator preservation.
body.gap: The construction definition names the traversal but does not itself prove the refinement and grid properties.
body.consumer: Every endpoint witness and categorical lift can be checked as a finite sequence of at-most-one-cell splits.
